Question B-005-001-006. Lesson link: L-005-01.

Why the correct answer is right: Kilo means 1 000, so one kilohm is 1000 ohms.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: This makes kilo a tenth instead of one thousand.
- sourceIndex 2: This makes kilo one thousandth instead of one thousand.
- sourceIndex 3: This is only ten ohms, not a kilohm.
